input_file_id.description: ID of the input file, must be a .jsonl file uploaded with purpose="batch"

endpoint.description: Request endpoint, currently only /v1/chat/completions is supported

completion_window.description: Time window for task processing, supports formats like 12h, 1d, 3d, minimum 12h, maximum 7d

metadata.description: Custom metadata, up to 16 key-value pairs, key max 64 chars, value max 512 chars
